gloss: full of ingredients; loaded with toppings

definitions.gloss: full of ingredients; loaded with toppings; hearty
definitions.explanation: Describes a dish, especially soups, stews, or sandwiches, that contains an abundance of solid ingredients. A positive descriptor suggesting a generous, satisfying meal.

examples.japanese: {具|ぐ}だくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made miso soup loaded with ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{具|ぐ}だくさんで⟦{食|た}べごたえ→食べごたえ：08039_tabegotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This boxed lunch is packed with ingredients and very filling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{具|ぐ}だくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シチュー→シチュー：10931_shichuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}めて→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{具|ぐ}だくさん is a な-adjective used almost exclusively to describe food. It has a strongly positive connotation, suggesting generosity, heartiness, and home-style cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {具|ぐ}だくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ (miso soup loaded with ingredients)
- {具|ぐ}だくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サンドイッチ→サンドイッチ：01366_sandoicchi⟧ (loaded sandwich)
- {具|ぐ}だくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧ (curry full of ingredients)
- {具|ぐ}だくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot with plenty of ingredients)

FORMS:
⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ means "ingredients" or "fillings" (as in ⟦{具材|ぐざい}→具材：06230_guzai⟧). だくさん is a variant of {沢山|たくさん} (plenty), with the initial た becoming だ through sequential voicing ({連濁|れんだく}).
